checkpoints.quote:
Error!
> To keep using mobile app, please log in to Online Banking and fill the customer's questionnaire.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis quotes the exact heading and message text matching the screenshot.
It mentions the OK button but never states it is the only button preventing dismissal into the app or explicitly ties it to blocking over the login screen.

checkpoints.quote: Screenshot `mob_app_login6_en.png` shows the login screen “Enter your Online Banking credentials” with User name TESTRELAXLUX4 filled, and an error modal.
checkpoints.reason: Username is correctly identified but the empty password field is never mentioned.
The analysis never notes the password field is empty or infers that the block occurs before authentication.

checkpoints.quote: Reproduction: Reporter states “Reproduced on our test account as well, so it is not specific to that customer.”
checkpoints.reason: Clearly states reproduction on test account and non-customer-specific nature, with correct version/unassigned context elsewhere.

checkpoints.quote: Comment by Tom Becker on 2026-09-15 09:55 notes: “The message is in the screenshot. Whatever it says, we need to know whether the app is meant to block login entirely or just warn, because right now the customer is stuck.”
checkpoints.reason: Directly quotes and highlights the unanswered question from Tom Becker.

checkpoints.quote: Clarify expected behaviour with Product Owner / Business: Is the login block intentional until the questionnaire is completed in Online Banking, or is the modal erroneously blocking all logins? Document the decision.
checkpoints.reason: Recommends confirming with product owner/business and documenting the decision, matching the expected next action.
The analysis reports the correct error text and does not invent a different error message or code.
The analysis never claims the customer can dismiss the dialog or that the password was rejected.
